messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "may need to prime your albuterol inhaler device before the first use"
set: ["may need to prime your albuterol inhaler device before the first use", "use the dose counter on your albuterol inhaler device", "may also need to shake your albuterol device just before each use", "always use the new inhaler device provided with your refill", "before first use", "may need to stop use before imaging tests", "follow all product instructions on how to clean your albuterol inhaler device and mouthpiece", "may need to stop use before surgery, medical procedure, or dental work", "allergy to albuterol", "kidney function may need to be checked before taking", "allergic reaction to albuterol", "press the device firmly against your skin", "shake the bottle before each use", "may need to temporarily stop taking", "Albuterol Inhalation", "use a medicine dose-measuring device"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
